summary.text: Heidi Workman is a Republican state representative who has represented Ohio House District 72 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a small business owner in the agricultural, manufacturing and real estate industries.

paragraphs.text: Workman was born in Salem, Ohio, and graduated from Carrollton High School.
She earned bachelor's degrees from Bowling Green State University in 2004 and Kent State University in 2011.
Ballotpedia says she has been affiliated with the National Rifle Association and Associated Builders and Contractors.
Workman defeated incumbent Gail Pavliga in the March 19, 2024 Republican primary for District 72 and won the general election on November 5, 2024 against Democrat Nathaniel Adams.
She sits on the Natural Resources, Government Oversight, Workforce and Higher Education, and Technology and Innovation committees, the last as vice chair, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a wife, mother of four, conservative activist, former registered nurse and small businesswoman, and listed limited government, lower taxes, education reform and protecting life among her positions.
Jeff Clapper (D) and Michael Fricke (L) are on the November 3, 2026 ballot with her.
